purpose: Test whether source decomposition/recombination helps on tasks whose symbols, thresholds, authority tokens and hidden cases are generated after protocol freeze and whose correct implementation requires multiple public source fragments.

public: solver.py with an intentionally incomplete implementation
a small set of public examples
no hidden oracle cases or private specification
private: hidden executable records and expected outputs

anti_copy_controls: all semantic constants and labels generated from the frozen post-freeze seed
correct behavior requires composition of multiple public source fragments
no private specification or hidden case is mounted into solver workspace
surface labels are task-specific random codewords
raw emitted artifact remains primary even when syntax-only sensitivity is reported

interpretation.positive: F2 improves protected hidden-oracle success versus strongest controls without critical failure or unreported resource advantage.
interpretation.negative: F2 ties/loses to simpler or parent controls, or its apparent gain disappears when raw executability or resources are considered.
interpretation.boundary: This suite supplies secondary fresh anti-copy/composition evidence only and cannot replace naturalistic E30/E40/E50 evidence.
